scope: Four synthetic prompt-development cases; not a held-out quality evaluation. Third run preceded final source-phrase filtering for optional use cases. No user transcripts.
findings: Concrete venue suggestions and table/portion caveats retained.
Negative repair experience and untried recommendation kept distinct.
Past-job and professional-practice locations were distinct in the final probe.
Hinglish summary retained the conditional weekend warning and uncertain price.
Optional model use-case phrases still added ranking/advice not present in source; final validator now drops phrases that are not contiguous source phrases.
Named-referrer preservation varied; the final prompt was reinforced, but broad semantic faithfulness remains unproven.
limits: Prompt iterated against these same cases; no independent generalization result.
Duration covers understanding only, not recording/upload/transcription.
Structured validation is not proof of semantic correctness.
